text: BAM share rose 0.09 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.11 percentage points over 7 days, to 32.7% of all Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.7% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3.
